howItWorks.title: How Chatter3 Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Practice English conversation with real people in minutes. Here's how it works — it's free, fun, and effective.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Sign up with your email or Google account. Choose your English level — beginner, intermediate, or advanced — and tell us your native language so we can match you better.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Click "Find Partner" and we'll match you with someone online who wants to practice too. Matches are based on your level, availability, and preferences.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Jump into a 1-on-1 video call and practice real English conversation. You'll earn Reward Points (RP) for every session — use them to extend your practice time or exchange for Free Points (FP).
howItWorks.feature1Desc: No textbooks or scripts. Practice with real people about topics that matter to you.
howItWorks.feature2Desc: Meet English learners from around the world. Every conversation is a cultural exchange.
howItWorks.feature3Desc: No waiting. Find a partner in seconds and start your practice session immediately.
howItWorks.feature4Desc: Get Reward Points for every call. The more you practice, the more you earn.
howItWorks.feature5Desc: Built-in reporting and moderation. Your safety is our priority.
howItWorks.feature6Desc: Daily Free Points for video calls. No credit card required. No hidden fees.
howItWorks.faq1Answer: Yes! You get Free Points (FP) every day for video calls. You can also earn Reward Points (RP) by completing sessions and referring friends.
howItWorks.faq2Question: How long are the video calls?
howItWorks.faq2Answer: Beginners get 5-minute sessions. Intermediate and advanced learners get 10-minute sessions. You can earn more time with RP.
howItWorks.faq3Question: What if I get a bad partner?
howItWorks.faq3Answer: You can report inappropriate behavior and we take action quickly. You can also end any call at any time.
howItWorks.faq4Answer: Yes, Chatter3 is a video conversation platform. You need a webcam or phone camera to participate.
howItWorks.bottomSubtitle: Join thousands of learners practicing English conversation every day.

forBeginners.title: English Conversation for Beginners
forBeginners.subtitle: Just starting your English journey? Chatter3 is the perfect place to practice speaking with real people — no pressure, no judgment.
forBeginners.feature1Desc: We match you with other beginners who are at the same level. No awkward conversations with advanced speakers.
forBeginners.feature2Desc: Short, focused sessions are perfect for beginners. Practice a little every day and build your confidence.
forBeginners.feature3Desc: Talk about everyday things — your hobbies, your day, your favorite food. No textbooks, just real conversation.
forBeginners.feature4Desc: Every conversation makes you better. The more you practice, the more natural English feels.
forBeginners.stepsTitle: How to Get Started as a Beginner
forBeginners.step1Desc: Create your account in 30 seconds. Select "Beginner" as your English level. That's it — no test, no pressure.
forBeginners.step2Desc: Tell us your native language and country. This helps us find you the best conversation partners.
forBeginners.step3Desc: Click "Find Partner" and we'll match you with another beginner. You'll both be learning together — it's comfortable and fun.
forBeginners.step4Desc: Your 5-minute session begins. Don't worry about making mistakes — that's how you learn! Just try your best and have fun.
forBeginners.tip1Desc: Mistakes are part of learning. Every fluent speaker started exactly where you are now.
forBeginners.tip2Desc: Talk about your name, your country, your hobbies, the weather. Simple topics are the best way to start.
forBeginners.tip3Desc: Even 5 minutes a day makes a huge difference. Consistency is more important than perfection.
forBeginners.tip4Desc: Pay attention to how your partner speaks. Try new words and phrases. That's how you improve fast.
forBeginners.faq1Question: What if I don't understand my partner?
forBeginners.faq1Answer: That's okay! Just say "Sorry, can you repeat that?" or "What does that mean?" Most people are happy to help.
forBeginners.faq2Question: Is it okay to use my native language sometimes?
forBeginners.faq2Answer: A little is fine, but try to speak English as much as possible. Even simple English is better than perfect native language.
forBeginners.faq3Question: How many sessions should I do per week?
forBeginners.faq3Answer: Try to do at least 3-5 sessions per week. The more you practice, the faster you'll improve.
forBeginners.bottomSubtitle: Join Chatter3 today and start speaking English with confidence.
